study.notes: STUDY: SURMOUNT-OSA (NCT05412004), two 52 week randomised double blind placebo controlled phase 3 studies of tirzepatide at the maximum tolerated dose (10 or 15 mg weekly, dose_mg 15 recorded as the target dose) vs placebo in adults with obesity and moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnoea; study 1 without PAP therapy (114 tirzepatide, 120 placebo), study 2 on PAP therapy (120 tirzepatide, 115 placebo), analysed as randomised; this Nature Medicine secondary report (Malhotra 2026) gives the prespecified cardiometabolic endpoints per study in Table 2: estimated treatment differences with 95 percent CI for SBP and DBP at week 48 (route ci_95, MD) and ETDs as estimate plus or minus standard error for the percent changes in hsCRP, lipids, fasting insulin and HOMA-IR at week 52 (route se_reported, PCT); HOMA-IR was analysed post hoc (prespecified FALSE on those rows); each study is entered as its own trial id (rows carry the study 2 n); weight change per study is in the primary N Engl J Med report (Malhotra 2024, not a packet text), pct_weight_change left empty for the companion pass; funded by Eli Lilly (industry_funded TRUE); population obstructive sleep apnoea with obesity, held under amendment A6; rob_overall low

json.design: SURMOUNT-OSA, two 52 week randomised double blind placebo controlled phase 3 studies, tirzepatide maximum tolerated dose vs placebo, obesity with moderate to severe obstructive sleep apnoea, 234 and 235 randomised
json.reason: population obstructive sleep apnoea with obesity, held under amendment A6 (Director decision on held populations); fourteen rows (seven inventory markers per study) extracted in full from Table 2 of the Nature Medicine cardiometabolic report and kept in staging; the group also holds the eClinicalMedicine early weight reduction post hoc analysis (no treatment contrast) and the N Engl J Med primary report by DOI only
other_markers: apnoea hypopnoea index and sleep apnoea specific hypoxic burden
mediation of the cardiometabolic effects by weight and OSA metrics

rob.justification: randomised double blind placebo controlled phase 3 program with a published protocol (D1, D2 low); mixed model repeated measures on participants as randomised (D3 low); laboratory and standardised pressure measurement under blinding (D4 low); cardiometabolic endpoints prespecified in the statistical analysis plan, HOMA-IR post hoc (D5 low)

doubts: held population: obstructive sleep apnoea with obesity; study 1 and study 2 are entered as separate trial ids
dose_mg 15 records the target maximum tolerated dose; participants received 10 or 15 mg
pct_weight_change and the baseline denominators for the lipid, insulin and HOMA-IR percent rows are not in this text; the N Engl J Med primary report is the companion for the pass
the eClinicalMedicine text (early weight reduction groups) carries no randomised contrast
